answer: A newcomer qualifies with a paired check in one morning: at dawn they photograph a lotus bed and log depth against a fixed basalt marker, then before noon repeat it at a distant quarry pool, where the keeper echoes the dawn entry in a separate log. Two reviewers compare timestamps, travel time and photos within five days. A reused photo, an impossible journey, or a duplicate claim voids both claims and bars the sponsor for a season. Faking it for a thousand identities would mean a thousand dawn-to-noon routes at once; one honest person needs only one morning.
